title: Open Small Business Records Taxonomy
classification_principle: Assign each record one primary family based on the part of the business accountable for the truth the record represents. Preserve other relevant contexts as relationships or metadata instead of competing primary copies.
accountability_test: If this record became wrong or disappeared tomorrow, who would have to deal with the consequence first?
tie_breakers: Classify by operational responsibility, not file format or generic document type.
Financial transaction evidence belongs in Finance, accounting & tax when finance is its primary purpose.
Use relationships for secondary contexts rather than creating competing primary homes.
Preserve required legal, regulatory, accounting, payroll, and contractual systems of record.

sensitivity_levels.context_dependent: Sensitivity varies materially with the particular record, business, customer, industry, and context.
sensitivity_levels.often_sensitive: This family often contains confidential, personal, commercial, location, account, or operational information that should be handled deliberately.
sensitivity_levels.highly_sensitive: This family commonly contains identity, financial, workforce, security, incident, access, legal-authority, or similarly consequential information.

recommended_record_metadata.purpose: Stable OSBRT family that owns the record's primary operational meaning.
Human record type without using it as the primary category.
Team, role, or business function accountable for correctness and follow-up.
Other OSBRT families that materially relate to the same record without becoming competing primary homes.
Pointer to the authoritative system, original, or governing record when the classified item is a representation or working copy. Never store secrets in this field.

categories.name: Governance & ownership
categories.definition: Entity, ownership, formal authority, and governance records.
categories.accountability_cue: Use when the accountable business area is Company governance or ownership.

applicability.when: Use when this family best represents the record’s primary operational responsibility.

sensitivity.note: Handling sensitivity depends on the specific record; use this family level only as a review cue.
